decisionContext: The owner explicitly approved both 24-row North Node source batches on 2026-09-05 and then authorized shipping the 48 approved North Node passages into the governed Calendar exact-aspect corpus by replying "yes please continue".
summary: An old hurt can make the next opportunity look dangerous for reasons that belong partly to what happened before.
body: An old hurt can make the next opportunity look dangerous for reasons that belong partly to what happened before. When Chiron squares the North Node, criticism, visibility, asking for help, trying again, or entering a similar situation can bring the earlier experience back into the decision with more authority than it deserves. The fear may still contain useful information about what needs protection now. Update the boundary, preparation, or support without assuming the only safe choice is never returning to anything that resembles the old problem.
